EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Future Sun Devil,
Thank you for expressing interest in the Interdisciplinary Arts & Performance (BA) <https://newcollege.asu.edu/interdisciplinary-arts-and-performance-degree> program at Arizona State University. Students engage with faculty in collaborative investigation of many disciplines, preparing for our complex and changing world through current approaches to artistic and aesthetic research. Students engage in practical and theoretical studies of visual, sonic, performance and interactive arts to become versatile artists. Student’s usually look to work as Arts Educators, Composers, Choreographers, Film/video editors, Graphic designers, Multimedia Installation Artists, Sound Artists, Theater Directors, Video Artists, Video Game designers, Visual Artists, and Visual Effects Animators among many others. By viewing the major map <https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/roadmaps/ASU00/ASIAPBA/null/ALL/2016>, you can see the degree requirements outlined for graduation.
Be sure to review our admission and application requirements <https://students.asu.edu/freshman/requirements> for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format. For finding more ways to pay for college, please visit our scholarships page <https://newcollege.asu.edu/college-scholarships>.
It's important to find the right fit for your undergraduate program. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can visit ASU and register for a tour <https://visit.asu.edu/> . We can’t wait to see you here at West campus! If you have any questions about New College, West campus, or one of our 35 programs, please contact our Recruitment Office through the information listed below. Thank you, and we’ll talk to you soon!
Kindest Regards,
New College Recruitment Team New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus asknewcollege@asu.edu 602-543-2890 {!Case.Thread_Id}
